title: External system form
purpose: Create an external system or change its name, kind, base address and whether it is active. Editing needs a reason.
summary: Describe one of the laboratory's other systems so staff can link to its records. Editing needs a reason. Only the admin role can open this form.

tasks.title: Add a system
steps: Enter the [[System name]] and choose its [[Kind]].
Add the [[Base address]] if links should be checked against it, then select [[Create system]].

tasks.title: Change a system
steps: Change the details and write the [[Reason for change]].

tasks.title: Stop offering a system
steps: Clear [[Active]], give the reason and save. Existing links stay.

good_to_know: When a base address is set, every link's address for this system must be on that host. Without one, its links take no address.
The key is a stable code. It cannot be changed after creation.
If someone else changed the system after you opened the form, saving is refused and your input stays.

items.label: System name
items.description: Required, up to 120 characters, unique among systems.

items.label: Key
items.description: Create only. Letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, up to 40 characters. Leave empty to make one from the name. It must be unused and never changes.

items.label: Kind
items.description: Laboratory information system (LIS), Laboratory information management system (LIMS), Electronic health record (EHR), Billing system, OpenBGA product or Other (the default).

items.label: Base address
items.description: Optional. An https:// address with a host and no user name or password. When set, a link's address must be on this host (and port). The application never opens or reads it itself. Changing it later leaves addresses on the former host as plain text that is no longer opened as a link.

items.label: Active
items.description: Edit only. An inactive system takes no new links. Existing links stay.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Edit only, required. Kept with the change in the history.

items.label: Create system / Save changes
items.description: Saves and returns to External systems. Each creation and change is audited with the person and time and, for changes, the reason and the values before and after. A save with no change is refused with Change at least one detail before saving. A name or key already used is refused.

items.label: Changed by someone else
items.description: If the system changed after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload and review it.

items.label: Inactive notice
items.description: While the stored system is inactive the form says it takes no new links and its existing links stay.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to External systems without saving.
